ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.1.1 Nested API Guard
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D.1.1 for RimWorld 1.5, based directly on the measured T34-C.4 baseline. Large JobGiver GenClosest scans are divided across the persistent RimMT worker pool. Worker threads execute overridden live HasJobOnThing validators while the caller joins the current batch. Direct and nested Reachability calls are intercepted before entering Region state, causing a silent current-call fallback and runtime scanner quarantine. Priority callbacks and default JobOnThing-backed validators remain on the main thread.
